body:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final production transparent PNG background sprite for an existing Unity slot-machine HELP paytable cabinet.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its handsome honey-wood, deep emerald green, restrained polished brass materials and rounded cartoon 3D game illustration.
Generate ONE isolated LOWER CABINET BODY ONLY. Front-facing orthographic, perfectly symmetric, tall width:height ratio 997:1575.5 (about 0.633). Target canvas 1024 x 1616. The asset tightly fills the image canvas edge to edge with only 1-2% transparent safety margin. Transparent alpha outside the silhouette, NO landscape, no floor shadow, no sky, no white background.
This is just the lower rectangular cabinet below the arched marquee in the reference: NO arched crown, NO bulbs, NO star, NO table, NO reel windows. Flat horizontal top edge at the top of canvas, slim rounded honey-wood side posts, warm brass inner frame, broad quiet deep forest emerald green inset over almost the entire front, rounded bottom corners, polished wood lower plinth and two modest small brass feet. Outer wood/brass 6-8% width each side, broad clear center. The top must be a straight open-ended horizontal cabinet join that a separately rendered marquee overlaps naturally, without a second rounded header.
Main central region from x=0.14 to 0.86, y=0.08 to 0.62 is calm blank dark green because the separate ivory reward table is overlaid in Unity. Footer text region x=0.18..0.82, y=0.64..0.87 must also remain quiet clear green. A few tasteful raised olive-green leaf vines and thin brass stems may be baked into far lower left and right peripheral edges ONLY (x<0.16 or x>0.84, y=.67..89), like reference. No art enters the central footer area.
Material: fine restrained emerald felt/enamel texture, soft cartoon bevel highlights, clean woodgrain, narrow golden brass trim. Match reference. No purple, no blue chrome, no huge inflated frame.
Absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, money, coins, symbols, paytable cells, icons, checkmark, buttons, handles, levers, plaques, additional panels. Do not draw any text placeholders. This image is only cabinet structure and restrained edge decoration. Actual transparent pixels outside, not a checkerboard drawing.
crown:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final production transparent PNG arched marquee sprite for an existing Unity slot-machine help paytable.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Recreate ONLY the gorgeous top arched crown on its wood/emerald slot machine, not the entire machine.
Generate ONE isolated front-facing symmetric arched marquee crown. Target width:height ratio 994:614 (about 1.619), canvas 1616 x 992 landscape. Tightly fill canvas with arch maximum at top, ends reaching left/right, flat bottom fascia at bottom, no more than 1-2% transparent margin. Transparent alpha outside arch silhouette. No background, ground, sky, floor shadow, cabinet body or paytable.
Shape: broad semi-elliptical arch with rounded honey-wood perimeter, narrow polished brass rims, dark forest emerald green interior. An arc of nine evenly spaced glowing warm ivory round bulbs traces just inside the outer rim. A single polished faceted gold five-point star centered in lower interior, flanked by one raised olive-green leaf on each side, exactly the tasteful star-and-two-leaves theme of reference. The bottom is one substantial flat horizontal brass fascia with rounded ends and a deep-green lower join, spanning full width; it needs to overlap seamlessly onto a separate rectangular cabinet body behind.
Style: polished high-quality casual mobile game 3D painted illustration, warm honeywood grain, restrained green enamel/felt texture, warm gold material, clean soft bevels. Strong silhouette, consistent front orthographic camera; no dramatic perspective, no extra attachments.
NO text, letters, numbers, logos, machine title, JACKPOT, SLOTS, 777. NO symbols except central decorative star and two leaves. NO reward table, coins, currency, reels, buttons, levers, lower cabinet, landscape. Actual transparent pixels outside, not checkerboard artwork.
